_notes: Portal Room slot registry. Slot anchor = SM_CraftedTeleporter_Lodestone static mesh actor.
Tiers by Z of the Lodestone: A = 255.4 (top), B = -394.6, C = -1044.6. Tier spacing = 650.
Slot number = rank by angle around room centre (-12950, 8380), counter-clockwise from +X (ascending degrees).
Rule checked against user-confirmed labels: A-1 Stone Garden, A-2 Torii (Japan), A-3 open, B-3 Cabin. User confirmed slot 1 is always Stone Garden and destinations never change.
Level C has no active portals in the current game version.
Pad positions are hand-placed and differ slightly from the mesh anchor. Existing pads: tier A pad Z = anchor +4.4. Pad yaw ~ container yaw + 91 (Cabin 32.7 on a -59 container).
Every teleporter ExitPoint is fixed at +215.1 forward, +127.5 up from the pad, so pad yaw alone decides where players exit. A spawned pad at the container yaw puts the exit inside a wall.
Proven placement for the 3rd slot of any tier (same XY on all tiers): pad XY (-13024.8, 7990.4), yaw 32.7; Z = 259.8 on tier A (Cabin on B-3 uses -416.8).
